scope: Source and evidence recheck of both games. Prior runtime tests and 400,000-book math audit are retained as evidence for their recorded versions, not described as a new run.

findings.finding: An invalid optional replay amount throws instead of using a safe default, preventing replay loading.
A replay response missing costMultiplier can pass validation and use the current local mode cost, which is not authoritative for that replay version.
findings.resolution: Require a positive finite response cost and remove local-cost substitution; preserve valid historical costs.

findings.finding: The normal service-error message map can resolve inherited object properties for untrusted error codes instead of a readable generic message.
findings.resolution: String and own-property allowlist plus regression.

findings.finding: Invalid replay currency values such as constructor, toString or __proto__ can select inherited metadata properties and throw during formatting.
findings.resolution: Safe metadata lookup and invalid optional replay currency handling, without relabelling authenticated wallet currencies.

findings.finding: Source title and prohibited-vocabulary checks do not establish publisher name clearance or comparative uniqueness.
findings.resolution: Publisher clearance remains required. No unilateral title change; Salmon's existing close-title reference is retained.
